title: HRIS System with Attendance Integration
features:
1. Engineered a Human Resource Information System (HRIS) integrating biometric attendance devices with a mobile backend.
  2. Developed a robust web platform for HR operations, including payroll, leave, and employee management.
  3. Implemented efficient synchronization between attendance logs and HR data using Express.js APIs.
  4. Focused on real-time processing, scalability, and secure employee data management.
